notes.title: Bottoms Up! : Part 1 - v 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
I finally got around to announce version 2.0 of the Visual Novel! 

The game now includes all the previously missing illustrations for Part 1 of the story and It looks and sounds exactly how I imagined it from the begining :). Suffice to say this makes me genuinly happy and I really wish you like it as well! 

Now the plan is to get to Part 2 as soon as possible...

- Hope I see you there! Cheers! 🍻

notes.title: Bottoms Up! : Part 1 - v 1.5 Update!
notes.content:
Bottoms Up! : Part 1 now has it`s first update - let`s call it v 1.5! :)

The update added 6 new illustrations to some of the scenes and fixed a few very silly bugs, which somehow went unnoticed until readers pointed them out! Thank you!

The new illustrations serve the purpose of flashbacks/story expositions and the plan was to include them from the start, but with drawing taking long, Me (the author) and the artist weren`t sure we will have the time! I really hope you like them! Furthermore, we would like to update the visual novel to v 2.0 soon to better present the more "mysterious" parts of the story.

It was really important for us to show you more of the main characters` lives and the fantasy world they live in! 

- See you there and cheers! 🍻
